Which Storage Type Is Right for Your Bedroom?
settings.subheading: The storage mechanism matters more than the design. Get it wrong and a beautiful bed becomes daily frustration - drawers that need 30" of clearance you don't have, or a hydraulic lid that hits the wall. Read this before you browse.
settings.column_1_text:
The full mattress platform lifts on gas pistons, opening one large cavity across the entire bed footprint. Up to 24 cu ft of unobstructed space - more than any other type. The mechanism locks open so you're not holding the mattress while you rummage for luggage.


Best for: Seasonal storage - winter quilts, luggage, off-season clothes. Items you access monthly, not weekly.

Critical requirement: 18–24" of clear wall space behind the headboard. This bed cannot sit flush against a wall. If your headboard is against a wall with zero gap, choose drawer or box storage instead.


Room size: 13 × 12 ft minimum. Piston warranty: 3 years.
settings.column_2_text:
Full-extension ball-bearing drawers - not cheaper roller runners - slide out from the side or foot of the bed. Two to six compartments, depending on the design, each accessible without disturbing the mattress or your partner.


Best for: Items you reach weekly: spare linens, clothing, books, children's things. Separate compartments mean no more digging through one large pile.

Critical requirement: 24–30" of clearance on whichever side(s) have drawers. Measure this before ordering - if a bedside table sits tight against the bed on the drawer side, the drawers cannot open.


Room size: 12 × 13 ft minimum. Storage: 12–18 cu ft across all drawers.
settings.column_3_text:
Three solid sheesham wood panels enclose the underbed space; one side stays open for direct access. No mechanism - slide in your own bins, baskets, or suitcases. Same solid sheesham frame construction as the other types, 15–20% lower price.

Best for: Bulky irregular items, buyers who prefer their own organising system, smaller bedrooms, and tighter budgets.

Room size: 12 × 12 ft minimum. Just 12–18" clearance is needed on the access side — the most space-efficient option.

settings.heading: Why Solid Sheesham Wood — And Why It Matters for a Storage Bed
settings.text_content:
Indian furniture buyers are right to be suspicious of 'wooden' labels. Most mid-range beds are MDF cores with a wood-grain laminate. Sheesham (Dalbergia sissoo — Indian Rosewood) is different in ways that are measurable, not just marketing.

Its density of ~770 kg/m³ means the frame won't wobble under the combined weight of two adults plus a loaded storage cavity — structural stress that cheap beds fail under in 3–4 years. Its natural oils provide termite resistance without chemical treatment, which matters specifically for storage beds: the enclosed underbed space has low airflow, and untreated wood in that environment attracts insects. Its interlocked grain limits seasonal expansion to 3–5%, so drawer runners work the same in June monsoon as in November dry season.

How long does it last? A properly built solid sheesham bed lasts 20–30 years. The storage mechanisms (pistons, slides) are the limiting factor, not the wood — and both are covered under warranty and replaceable. Every bed in this collection is solid sheesham throughout: frame, rails, slats, storage panels. No veneers. No particleboard cores. No 'sheesham finish' laminates.

🏭 Handcrafted in Jodhpur - India's furniture manufacturing capital since 1947. Every joint hand-fitted; every finish hand-applied. Rated 4.8 / 5 from 100+ verified buyers.

settings.heading: What is the exact size of a king-size bed in India, and will it fit a standard Indian king-size mattress?
settings.text: Indian king-size mattress dimensions are 78" × 72" (6.5 ft × 6 ft). All beds in this collection are built for these dimensions. Do not buy a US or UK king-size mattress — they are 76" × 80" and will not fit correctly. Our bed frames have a 78" × 72" sleeping surface. The overall frame including headboard and footboard overhang is approximately 84" × 78".

settings.heading: Hydraulic vs drawer storage - which is better for a 12×12 bedroom?
settings.text: In a 12×12 bedroom, both work, but with different constraints. A hydraulic bed requires 18–24" of clearance behind the headboard — if your bed is against a wall, measure whether you have that gap. A drawer bed requires 24–30" on whichever side the drawers face. A box storage bed works in the tightest configuration. If your bedroom is 12×12 with standard wall placement on two sides, box storage or drawer storage (with careful layout planning) is the most practical choice.

settings.heading: Is solid sheesham wood termite-resistant without chemical treatment?
settings.text: Yes. Sheesham (Dalbergia sissoo) contains natural oils that provide inherent resistance to termites and wood-boring insects. This is different from woods that are chemically treated for termite resistance — chemical treatments degrade over time and require re-treatment. Sheesham's natural oil content is a structural property of the wood itself. However, no wood is termite-proof under extreme infestation conditions — if your building has a serious termite problem, address it at the structure level regardless of your furniture material.

settings.heading: What mattress thickness works best with a storage bed?
settings.text: Any standard thickness from 4" to 12" will work mechanically with these frames. However, storage beds sit higher than standard platform beds (sleeping surface at 26–30" from the floor vs. 22–24" for a platform bed). A very thick mattress (12"+) can push your sleeping height uncomfortably high and make the bed dominate the room visually. Most buyers choose a 6–8" mattress for best proportion on a storage bed frame.

settings.heading: How long do the hydraulic pistons last, and can they be replaced?
settings.text: Our hydraulic pistons are rated for 3,000–5,000 lift cycles. At 3–4 uses per week (generous estimate for seasonal storage), that's 14–32 years of operational life. The first 3 years are covered under warranty. After warranty, piston replacement is available as a paid service — the pistons are standard-sized components that can be sourced and replaced without replacing the bed frame. Hydraulic piston replacement typically costs ₹2,000–₹4,000 per pair.

settings.heading: Do you offer assembly, and what does 'assembled delivery' mean?
settings.text: 'Assembled delivery' means the bed arrives in a ready-to-use state - you don't need to construct it. Some larger beds (particularly hydraulic models) may ship in two sub-assemblies (headboard + base) that click together in under 20 minutes. Assembly assistance is available in Bengaluru, Mumbai, Delhi NCR, Pune, and Hyderabad - confirm at checkout. For other cities, detailed photo-instruction assembly guides are provided, and our support team is available by phone for guidance.

settings.heading: What mattress should I use with these beds, and does thickness matter?
settings.text: Any standard king-size mattress (78" × 72") works—memory foam, latex, innerspring, hybrid, whatever you prefer. The slatted base provides adequate airflow for foam mattresses, so you don't need a box spring. One consideration: storage beds sit higher than standard beds (sleeping surface at 26-30" versus 22-24" for platform beds), so thicker mattresses (12"+) might put you uncomfortably high for easy bed entry/exit and can make the bed dominate the room visually. Many buyers prefer 6-8" mattresses on storage beds for better proportion. Just confirm the mattress dimensions match Indian king size (78"×72"), not US/UK king (76"×80")—imported mattresses may not fit properly.

settings.heading: Any Vastu guidelines for placing a king-size bed with storage?
settings.text: According to Vastu Shastra, the ideal placement for the master bed is in the southwest corner of the bedroom, with the head pointing south or east. The bed should not face the door directly, and the storage access side should not face north. If your layout requires the hydraulic bed to be away from the wall for access, the south or west wall placement typically accommodates the clearance requirement naturally.
